description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Boonweaver Giant trigger, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
